findings.reason: the followup's prompt is the build invocation a coordinator acts on, so leaving two done sections in it spends two nodes and two loops on work the plan itself records as finished.
findings.text: the plan's only section-naming followup says "Sections 3, 29, 33, 35, 36 and 41 are the plan's remaining implementable work" and its prompt is `/reckon-build queued-work-needs-no-workaround §3 §29 §33 §35 §36 §41`, while the section declarations at plan.html:23 read `s33: done` and `s35: done`, so a dispatcher following it launches two nodes for sections already landed

findings.reason: a landed section whose declared evidence artifact was never produced cannot be opened by a later reader, so the plan needs either the fragment produced or the declaration repointed, and s41 repeats the same declared path so the gap will recur unless it is settled.
findings.text: sections 37 and 40 are declared `done` and each names `docs/evidence/fragments/queued-work-needs-no-workaround/sNN.html` as a write path, but neither `s37.html` nor `s40.html` exists in the tree and `git log -- s40.html` returns no commit (seven of the twenty declared `sNN.html` paths are absent: s16, s17, s21, s27, s28, s37, s40)
